product.title: Sun Visor Organizer Clip
product.descriptionHtml:
Keep sunglasses, cards and small essentials within reach with a simple sun-visor organizer clip.

  • Designed to hold lightweight everyday items
  • Compact option for tidier in-car storage
  • Select the available colour or configuration you prefer

Fit and capacity can vary by vehicle visor and selected option. Check the variant details before ordering.
